### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. *I wish Ciger could probe NVMe / UFS 4.0 extended attributes...*)

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or feature you'd like to see added.

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context / Hardware Details
Add any other context, sysfs paths (`/sys/...`), or documentation regarding the hardware feature.
